receipt.meaning: Bounded internally-recomputable read-observation reference; no provider signature, transaction proof or user authorization

compares: identical EC162 pin and EC163 coverage
ordered sanitized path metadata per page, counts and paging

raw HTTP JSON body digest in memory if transport supplies it

single_file_version.github_claim: Selected GH file sha is provider-declared blob OID, not proof that it belongs to pinned head

coverage.COMPLETE: Only EC163 provider-reported changed-path enumeration; NOT an atomic snapshot

coverage.missing_http_validator: UNKNOWN provider version, no upgrade of coverage
